text: Customer Portal Rebuild is Green and on track for go-live on Tuesday 1 December. This fortnight the account settings and billing history screens were completed, and the new login flow tested well: all 12 test customers logged in unaided, and login time fell from 48 to 21 seconds. An external accessibility audit found three minor issues, all now fixed. Spend is $186,000 of $310,000, in line with plan. The helpdesk integration risk has dropped to low. No decisions are needed. Next fortnight: build the support ticket screen, start load testing, and draft customer communications for marketing review.
